name: Contrast Checker
description: Check if two colours are readable: WCAG ratio, AA and AAA for normal and large text, a live preview and a button that fixes the colour.
prompt: A colour contrast checker with a live preview of text on a background, the WCAG contrast ratio, AA and AAA results for normal and large text, swapping colours, a button that fixes the text colour and example pairs that pass.
author: gonzaroman

description_i18n.es: Comprueba si dos colores se leen bien: ratio WCAG, AA y AAA para texto normal y grande, vista previa y un botón que arregla el color.
